forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: ParamType object case; GraphQLArguments publishes its parameter descriptors
+---
+A GraphQL tool's `variables` argument is refused when a script sends a JSON object, because ParamType / OperationParameterType have no object case, so tools hand-code `variables` as `.string` (FoundationModelsACPAgent KanbanOperationTool.swift:91). SWE-bench kanban24 django__django-14997: "Tool "runKanban" argument "variables" must be string, got an object instead."
+
+- [ ] Add `.object` to ParamType (Operations) and OperationParameterType (Extras): a JSON object; text that holds one JSON object is accepted too
+- [ ] Map it in OperationParameterType(ParamType), SchemaFusion dynamicSchema (anyOf string | object, like GraphQLArguments), CLI fallback convert + type name
+- [ ] GraphQLArguments.parameterDescriptors: query string required, variables object optional, operationName string optional
+- [ ] Tests first
+
+Requested by foundationmodelsacpagent-96; Multitool (foundationmodelsmultitool-35) then accepts `.object` in its argument check. #graphql
\ No newline at end of file
